integrity: The proof uses exact expectation values, an exact Jacobian, and exact linear algebra; finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
The source establishes the OVQITE/VIME equations and the need for a descent check but does not supply this explicit minimal exact counterexample in the inspected text.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local and does not claim that VIME typically moves uphill or that Armijo-accepted steps increase energy.
The explicit qubit algebra embeds into a fixed-parity two-mode fermionic sector, but no end-to-end molecular c-tUPS instance is claimed.
No frequency, genericity, or necessity theorem is asserted for multi-term pools beyond the proved one-term minimality boundary.
title: A minimal exact uphill direction for termwise Hamiltonian-pool OVQITE
